user.title: Connect to IoTrix Cloud
user.description: Paste the access token from your IoTrix account. The default regional API host normally needs no changes. Devices are discovered from the cloud response; no device IDs are hardcoded.

data_description.host: IoTrix regional API endpoint. Change it only if your account uses another region.
data_description.token: IoTrix account access token. It is stored in Home Assistant and excluded from logs and diagnostics.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect IoTrix Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: The saved token was rejected. Enter a replacement access token.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to IoTrix Cloud

abort.already_configured: This IoTrix account is already configured

init.title: IoTrix Cloud options
init.description: Configure how often Home Assistant refreshes the cloud-owned device list. Realtime values continue over WebSocket.
